pr.description: Open the pull request for the current git branch

jira.description: Open the Jira ticket matching the current branch prefix (needs HUB_JIRA_HOST)

web.description: Open the current worktree in the workspace manager (needs HUB_WEB_URL_CMD)

repo.description: Open the repository for the current workspace (worktree or root) in a browser
repo.command: remote=$(git remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null); if [ -z "$remote" ]; then echo "No git remote 'origin' found in the current directory."; exit 1; fi; url=$(printf "%s" "$remote" | sed -E 's#^(https?://)[^@/]+@#\1#; s#^ssh://([^@/]+@)?([^:/]+)(:[0-9]+)?/#https://\2/#; s#^git@([^:/]+):#https://\1/#; s#\.git/?$##'); open "$url"; echo "Opening the repo at $url in a browser"
